scripts.tauri:dev:log: bun run log:backup && LOG=true tauri dev
scripts.log:backup: cd src-tauri/logs && TODAY=$(date +%Y-%m-%d) && echo "TODAY: $TODAY" && echo "Checking file: proxy.log.$TODAY" && if [ -f proxy.log.$TODAY ]; then echo "File exists, starting backup process" && for i in {99..1}; do if [ -f proxy.log.$TODAY.old$i ]; then echo "Moving proxy.log.$TODAY.old$i to proxy.log.$TODAY.old$((i+1))" && mv proxy.log.$TODAY.old$i proxy.log.$TODAY.old$((i+1)); fi; done && echo "Moving proxy.log.$TODAY to proxy.log.$TODAY.old1" && mv proxy.log.$TODAY proxy.log.$TODAY.old1 && echo "Backup completed"; else echo "File does not exist"; fi
scripts.log:generate: npm run log:backup && cd /Users/yoon/Documents/workspace/proxelar && timeout 20s cargo run -p proxyapi_v2 --example log
